profile.headline: Tech Lead Software Engineer at Cardinal Health | Healthcare Technology | Pharmacy & Warehouse Applications | Health Care Product Engineering | Technical Leadership
profile.summary:
Professional Experience in IT industry, experience specializing in object-oriented design and analysis with extensive experience in full life cycle of software development process including requirements, prototyping, design, implementation, testing and maintenance. Skilled in Software development using Agile and Scrum/Kanban methodology. 

Technical Skills:

• Programming Languages: Java (EE), ASP.NET, C#.
• Web Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, AngularJs, EmberJS, jQuery, REST API.
• Architecture & Framework: MVC, Spring, Hibernate.
• Server & Databases: Tomcat, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Tools: DevExtreme, JasperSoft Studio, Toad for Oracle, Postman, VMware vSphere.
• Charts: Google Charts, Highcharts.js.
• Simulators/IDE: Eclipse, NetBeans, Visual Studio, Sublime.
• Debugging & Testing: Chrome Dev, Firebug, Qunit.
• Version Control Tools: Git, SVN.
• Software Methodologies: UML, Design Pattern, Agile Methodology.
• Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, Mac OS X.
• Have sound knowledge in networking protocols and Operating Systems.
• Sound Knowledge of Computer Hardware and Components.

positions.title: Tech Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead Software Engineer with extensive experience in healthcare technology, pharmacy applications, warehouse management systems, and Fulfillment-to-Dispense (F2D) workflows.

Experienced in leading software development initiatives, designing scalable solutions, driving system integrations, resolving complex production challenges, and mentoring engineering teams.

Strong expertise in pharmacy operations, eRX workflows, warehouse applications, and end-to-end fulfillment processes, delivering reliable and efficient technology solutions.

Passionate about technical leadership, software architecture, engineering excellence, system performance, and cross-functional collaboration to drive business value.
positions.insights: Solution Owner, Technical Leadership and +2 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leading as the recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Pharmacy applications and eRX flow,
  demonstrating an exceptional level of expertise.
• Successfully resolved critical production issues, showcasing the ability to handle high-pressure
  situations and ensuring minimal disruptions to operations.
• Played a key role in the implementation of eRx Flow for the Pharmacy project, contributing to the successful execution of this critical initiative.
• Mentored and coached team members in the adoption of best practices for writing self-documenting and maintainable code, fostering a culture of continuous improvement in coding standards.
• Collaborated extensively with cross-functional teams to gain deep insights into various healthcare domains, allowing for the development of tailored solutions that effectively addressed industry-specific challenges.
• Established and promoted unit testing practices for both positive and negative scenarios, resulting in a substantial reduction in software defects and an overall enhancement in the quality of the product.
• Actively participated in requirement gathering sessions, working closely with stakeholders to thoroughly understand their needs and expectations, ensuring alignment with project goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• As a Software Engineer with GE Nuclear Digital team I was responsible for developing and implementing solutions for software to be used both internally for GE Nuclear Engineering and at Nuclear Power Plants around the US.
• Programed a feature and or a small feature set using C#. asp.Net,SQL,HTML5,CSS3, JavaScript and modify existing features and fixed bugs in the existing products with Agile Methodology.
• Contributed to the team and work with direction from Senior Team Member or management, beginning to work independently and help team member through pair programming and code reviews.
• Implemented core data structures and algorithms using language ASP.NET, break down problems, documenting problem statements and estimating efforts.

positions.title: Software Engineer -TIP Technologies
positions.description:
• Developed web products Supplier Quality Management (TipSQM®) and Shop Floor Execution (TipSFE®) at TIP with high quality for TIP customers in Defense, Aviation and Space industries for Quality Analysis.
• Worked on full phase of software development using Java with Spring & Hibernate, SQL, AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3 with SASS, Bootstrap and add new features, modify existing features and fixed bugs in the existing enterprise products with Agile Methodology.
• Designed database schema using JPA2 and Hibernate in implementation of Spring MVC framework and developed DAO, DTO and service layers.
• Configured the controllers and different beans such as Handler mapping, View Resolver, Apache Tomcat and Working With spring modules (Core, Context, DAO, ORM, MVC).
• Developed backend and API services, Implemented Spring Security against authentications and Web request security.
• Created the dynamic reports using JasperReports(Open source) and JasperSoft Studio.
• Profound knowledge and expertise in DevExtreme framework, an advanced library to display and handle data in forms of grids, charts, perform Mapping etc.
• Created the Virtual machine in server host using VMware vSphere and installed OS and setup JIRA application.
• Actively involved in technical, design, code and test protocol reviews.
• Delivered of software solution consistent with the product road map and released plan milestones.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and Implemented re-usable web components Framework using web technologies such as 
   Emberjs, Handlebar, JavaScript, JQuery, HTML5 and CSS3 with Agile Methodology.
• Responsible for developing components as responsive, web accessible (WCAG 2.0 AA conformance) 
   and checking cross browser compatibility on different browsers like Safari, Google chrome, Internet 
   Explorer, Mozilla and Firefox.
• Conducted unit testing using Qunit.
• Involved in Implementation and bug fixing the application.
• Collaborated with teammates and updated application versions using Git with Bitbucket.
• Used JIRA to track development process and defects.

projects.title: A Weather and traffic Analytics System
projects.description:
• Used Weather API and Google Map API to get all weather, Routes and traffic information and store it into MySQL database. Developed different methods for manipulating the weather data from database and represented as the user request.
• Build Application Using Ant, Created XML file that building and running application easy.
• Data visualization using Google Charts and Tables.
Environment: JAVA, HTML, CSS, MySQL, Google Map API, Weather API.

projects.title: Online Quiz
projects.description:
• It enables students to take quizzes and check their grade. Used pedestal web application framework
as a server side component and MongoDB database to persist the data. To build Event-driven architecture, used Clojure Script to handle client side events.
